## Change

What user-visible problem does this solve? Briefly explain the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks run, their results, and any platform/provider checks not run.
For UI changes, include a screenshot or short recording when helpful.

## Diagnostics

For bugs: attach reviewed diagnostic Markdown, or link a redacted committed
`tests/reports/your-report.md`. Remove credentials and private data first.
For features/docs, explain why diagnostics do not apply using the format in
CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Review

- [ ] This is a focused change; relevant behavior and regression checks are included.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under GPLv2-or-later.
- [ ] No credentials, private workspace data or unrelated generated files are included.
